_meta.what: id -> archetype for the eval sample's RANDOM remainder. The gold set covers its own twelve; this covers the rest, so `report` can apply the chokepoint scope split mechanically for every case instead of only for the curated floor.
_meta.why: Growing n buys statistical power for the four always-in-scope rubric rows and NONE for the two chokepoint-scoped ones — their stable in-scope N stays at the four curated chokepoint cases until the rest of the sample carries a label. Those two are the moves the harness's own retrospective calls the weakest-reproduced, which is most of what a larger n is being bought for.
_meta.provenance: One-time pass by scripts/eval/archetype_label_workflow.js (sonnet), each case labelled from its own thesis text with a one-clause reason recorded below. FROZEN: never re-derived at judge time. A borderline case re-scoped on every pass can flip n/a<->0 between two scorings of the identical answer, which reads as a regression with zero underlying change.
_meta.how_to_correct: A label that looks wrong is corrected HERE, by hand, with its `why` updated — not by re-running the pass, which would move other labels too and break comparability with every run already scored against this file.
